findings.evidence: `.research/mergify/merge-queue_lifecycle.md:150-170` requires immediate removal for a base conflict. `cargo run -q -p schlange -- sim run scenarios/p1-conflict-ahead.yaml` exited 0 and dequeued #5 with `CONFLICT_WITH_BASE_BRANCH`; all invariants passed. External-reset conflict scenarios also exited 0.

`.research/mergify/merge-queue_lifecycle.md:140-168` requires holding in place, resuming if the predecessor leaves, and dequeuing if it merges. `p1-conflict-ahead.yaml` exited 0 and demonstrated all three outcomes with `CONFLICT_WITH_PULL_AHEAD`/`CONFLICT_WITH_BASE_BRANCH`.

`.research/mergify/schema.json:2472-2478` defaults to `always`; lifecycle lines 312-322 require rebuilding on a manually moved base. `p1-base-moved.yaml` exited 0, rebuilt both cars with `MERGE_QUEUE_RESET`, and preserved the hotfix. `cargo test -p schlange-forge --test dsl merged_by_hand_while_queued -- --exact` passed for `PR_MANUALLY_MERGED`.

The schema says `never` leaves the queue unchanged and does not re-evaluate after an external merge (`.research/mergify/schema.json:2472-2478`). `crates/schlange-core/src/queue.rs:226-234` disables this behavior for branch-landing methods. `cargo test -p schlange-forge --test p2 merge_batch_with_never_resets_after_an_external_push -- --exact` passed while explicitly asserting `MERGE_QUEUE_RESET`.

`cargo run -q -p schlange -- sim run scenarios/p1-semantic-conflict.yaml` exited 0: #2 was tested on the speculative combination with #1, failed `full`, and was dequeued while #1 and unrelated #3 landed; I0-I5 passed.

`cargo test -p schlange-forge --test localgit line_level_merge_differs_from_the_in_memory_model -- --exact` passed: real Git merged different-line edits while the deliberately file-level in-memory model reported a conflict.

The schema defines boolean `conflict` at `.research/mergify/schema.json:2868-2872`, but `crates/schlange-core/src/eval.rs:164-220` has no evaluator case. `config validate --strict crates/schlange-config/tests/golden/unsupported.yml` exited 2 and reported `attr:conflict` unsupported by `queue-conflicts`.

summary: Targeted validation and all queue-conflicts scenarios/tests passed. MQ-09 remains incomplete because `docs/mq-coverage.md:27` explicitly says reopening is untested. The full workspace suite could not finish green: after rerunning with localhost permission, an unrelated config golden test failed because its `conflict_resolvers` fixture no longer satisfies the pinned schema. No copied Mergify code or documentation prose was found outside `.research/`.
